  - 08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT / 16:00 BST
Option B — Wed Sep 3

If neither works, let me know two alternatives and I’ll re-propose. Proposed agenda (30–45 min): brief product demo (15), architecture deep dive (15), Q&A + next steps (10).

Attachments: postcall-deck.pdf (post-call slide deck), proposed-times.ics (proposed windows). I’m cc-ing Ben (SE) so he can flag any pre-demo artifacts we should prepare.

If you didn’t receive the original deck or the calendar item, tell me which email best reaches your scheduling team and I’ll resend individually.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

Best,
